# Steering motion vectors (HidSteeringReader arithmetic with an injected clock).
# Frozen from the legacy C# implementation by tools/G29.Reference (reference.ps1).
# Do not edit by hand. These vectors are the oracle for the Brainfuck port.
# axis <logical min> <logical max> <bit size>   => effective <min> <max>   (starts a new reader)
# sample <time us> <raw>                          one accepted HID input report
# motion <time us> => <position> <velocity> <acceleration>
# Legacy tuning: velocity full scale 40000, acceleration full scale 400000, smoothing 0.4, still after 50 ms,
# poll after 250 ms without samples, minimum sample interval 0.5 ms.

axis 0 65535 16 => effective 0 65535
axis 0 -1 16 => effective 0 65535
axis 0 0 16 => effective 0 65535
axis -32768 32767 16 => effective -32768 32767
axis 5 1 10 => effective 0 1023
axis 0 1023 10 => effective 0 1023
axis 0 -1 40 => effective 0 2147483647
